_comment: Snapshot expectations, not biological constants. Observed on the first full run of all enabled evidence layers (uniprot + glygen + structure; glyconnect disabled as corroboration-only). The uniprot_* counts are inherited unchanged from uniprot_baseline_2026-04-27.json - enrichment adds sites, it must never move the baseline, so any drift in all_sites/all_proteins here is a wiring bug rather than a data update. The enriched_* counts additionally depend on the GlyGen response cache (data/cache/glygen_protein_detail.jsonl, 1714 accessions - the candidates carrying a GlyGen cross-reference, the rest answer HTTP 500) and on the cached PDB structures (484 candidate accessions present in the structure manifest). A mismatch means the cache, the structures, or the upstream tables changed - investigate the inputs before editing this file. Note: the filename carries the plan's date (2026-08-06, per the implementation plan this snapshot fulfills); snapshot_date below carries the date the numbers were actually generated (see results/provenance.json generated_at) - these are expected to differ and that is not a bug.
_contribution: Of the 912 positive sites, 505 carry UniProt support (the unchanged baseline) and 407 are net new: 375 supported by GlyGen alone, 24 by a structural glycan linkage alone, and 8 by both. Structure's independent contribution is therefore 32 sites, matching the pre-run expectation; GlyGen's 375 sits at the upper end of the projected +100 to +400 range.
